name: Light/dark box
description: A box split into a brightly lit compartment and a dark, enclosed compartment connected by an opening. Measures anxiety-like behaviour: anxious animals avoid the light side and cross between the compartments less often.

parameters.label: Box length
parameters.help: Inside length of the whole box from the light end wall to the dark end wall, along the horizontal axis of the camera image.

parameters.label: Box depth
parameters.help: Inside depth of the box, front wall to back wall, along the vertical axis of the camera image.

parameters.label: Light compartment share
parameters.help: Length of the light compartment as a share of the box length, measured to the partition. 50% means both compartments are equally long.

parameters.label: Tracking gap tolerance
parameters.help: If the animal is lost for longer than this, the movement across the gap is not counted. Raise it only for low frame rate videos.

zones.label: Light compartment
zones.geometry: 0 <= x < box_width_cm x light_fraction, within the box.

zones.label: Dark compartment
zones.geometry: box_width_cm x light_fraction <= x <= box_width_cm; the dividing line belongs to the dark side.

events.label: Light compartment visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in light.

events.label: Dark compartment visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in dark.

events.label: Light compartment entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering light.

events.label: Dark compartment entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering dark.

metrics.label: Analyzed duration
metrics.description: Time during which the animal could be tracked.
metrics.definition: Samples are box-local centimeters with the origin at the light-side corner; samples outside the box count as lost. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples with 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in light
metrics.description: Less time in the light compartment suggests more anxiety-like behaviour.
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the light compartment.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in dark
metrics.description: Time spent in the dark compartment.
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the dark compartment.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Share of time in light
metrics.description: Part of the analyzed duration spent in the light compartment.
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration in the light compartment.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Light entries
metrics.description: How many times the animal crossed from the dark into the light compartment.
metrics.definition: Counted intervals from dark to light.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Transitions
metrics.description: Total crossings between the two compartments in either direction; fewer transitions suggest more anxiety-like behaviour or lower activity.
metrics.definition: Counted intervals whose samples are in different compartments.
metrics.formula: count(light to dark) + count(dark to light)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Latency to dark
metrics.description: Time from the start of the trial until the animal first enters the dark compartment.
metrics.definition: Time of the first tracked sample inside the zone, from the trial start. The zone is dark.
metrics.formula: first tracked sample time in dark
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when no tracked sample is inside the zone; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.
